snippet.description:
Area of Polar Curves B.Sc Maths | Quadrature & Integral Calculus Solved Problems. Learn how to find area bounded by polar curves r = f(θ) step-by-step with standard formulas and university exam examples.

Is video lecture mein hum detail mein discuss karenge ki Polar Curves (ध्रुवीय वक्र) jaise se bounded area (क्षेत्रफल) kaise calculate karte hain. Agar aap B.Sc. Maths, B.Tech / Engineering Mathematics ya kisi competitive exam ki preparation kar rahe hain, toh yeh topic exams ke liye bahut important hai.

📌 What you will learn in this lecture:
👉 Introduction to Polar Quadrature (ध्रुवीय वक्रों का क्षेत्रकलन)
👉 Sectoral Area ka Formula: $\int \frac{1}{2} r^2 , d\theta$ ka derivation aur concept
👉 Limits of integration ($\alpha$ se $\beta$) kaise set karein
👉 Polar curves trace karke area find karne ka step-by-step method
👉 University exams mein repeatedly poochhe gaye important solved examples

💡 Practice Tip: Har example ko video pause karke pehle khud solve karne ki koshish karein taaki concepts aur curve tracing aur better clear ho sakein.

00:00 - Introduction & Cartesian vs Polar Curves Recap
01:04 - Formula & Derivation: Area of a Polar Sector
05:07 - Example 1: Area of Cardioid r = a(1 + cosθ)
11:53 - Example 2: Area of Lemniscate r² = a²cos(2θ) (Two Loops)
19:22 - Example 3: Common Area Between Circle r = a & Cardioid r = a(1 + cosθ)
28:33 - Example 4: Area Between Cardioid r = a(1 - cosθ) & its Double Tangent
42:31 - Summary & Preview of Next Lecture (Double Integrals)

Agar aapko kisi bhi step me doubt ho toh comment karke zaroor poochiye. Video ko like karein, share karein aur channel ko subscribe karna na bhulein!

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨
